hits.title: OverDrive Appoints Marc DeBevoise Chief Executive Officer; Founder Steve Potash Named Chairman of the Board - OverDrive
hits.snippet: CLEVELAND — June 23, 2026 — OverDrive announced today that veteran media and technology executive Marc DeBevoise has been appointed Chief Executive Officer. Founder Steve Potash has assumed the role of Chairman of the Board, ensuring a smooth transition and continuing to advance the company’s mission to expand access to reading and learning for institutions worldwide. ... The leadership transition reflects a planned succession designed to support OverDrive’s continued growth and global expansion. Potash founded OverDrive 40 years ago and has guided the company from an early digital content venture into a global, purpose-built platform serving libraries and schools in more than 115 countries. DeBevoise, having previously served as CEO of Brightcove, Chief Digital Officer of Paramount, and CEO of CBS Interactive, joined OverDrive as President and has worked alongside founder Steve Potash to position the company for its next phase of growth.

hits.title: Marc DeBevoise Appointed OverDrive CEO
hits.snippet: Marc DeBevoise Appointed OverDrive CEO # Marc DeBevoise Appointed OverDrive CEO Jun 23, 2026 Marc DeBevoise has been appointed CEO of OverDrive, succeeding founder Steve Potash in the role, the digital content provider announced today. The leadership transition was planned and is “designed to support OverDrive's continued growth and global expansion," per an announcement. DeBevoise, who previously held leadership roles at video platform Brightcove and online content network CBS Interactive, first joined Overdrive earlier this year as president. "Founding and building OverDrive has been the most rewarding journey of my career," said Potash, who will stay on as chairman of the board, said in a statement. "With Marc leading as CEO, the company is exceptionally well positioned to grow and evolve. As Chairman, I look forward to supporting Marc and our team while continuing to champion the libraries, schools, and institutions at the heart of our mission."

hits.title: OverDrive CEO Steve Potash Transitions to New Role | Library Journal
hits.snippet: OverDrive announced leadership transition with founder and CEO Steve Potash named Chairman of the Board. Marc DeBevoise will become next OverDrive CEO. ... As OverDrive marks its 40th year in business, founder Steve Potash is embarking on a significant leadership transition, moving from his long-held role as CEO to become the Chairman of the Board. Marc DeBevoise, a veteran media and technology executive who was named President of OverDrive in March, will be his successor. This shift, announced on June 23, signals a new chapter for the company and a personal evolution for Potash, as he moves away from day-to-day operations to focus on global advocacy for literacy, support for public learning institutions, and promoting universal access to knowledge.
